content: The text provided appears to be a list of references from various studies and articles, formatted in a fragmented and non-standard way. It includes details about authors, titles, journals, publication years, and other bibliographic information. 1. Cole A, Towse A, Lorgelly P, and Sullivan R (2018) analyzed the economic implications of innovative payment models compared to single pricing strategies for pharmaceuticals. Their findings were published in OHE Research Paper 18. 2. Conti RM, Nguyen KH, and Rosenthal MB (2018) investigated the impact of generic prescription drug price increases and identified which products might be affected by proposed anti-gouging legislation. This study was published in the Journal of Pharmaceutical Policy and Practice. 3. Costa RD, Osorio-de-Castro CG, Silva RM, Maia AA, Ramos MC, and Caetano R (2015) conducted an analysis of medicine procurement for Alzheimer’s disease in Brazil, focusing on federal purchase data. Their findings appeared in Value in Health. 4. Costa-Font J, McGuire A, and Varol N (2014) explored the effects of price regulation on the adoption delays of generic drugs. This research was published in the Journal of Health Economics. 5. Costa-Font J and Puig-Junoy J (2004) examined the pharmaceutical market regulation in Spain, questioning the effectiveness of drug cost-containment policies. Their study was published in the Journal of Pharmaceutical Finance and Economic Policy. 6. Cubanski J, Frank RG, and Epstein AM (2004) evaluated the savings potential of drug discount cards for Medicare beneficiaries. Their findings were published in Health Affairs. 7. Dafny L, Ody C, and Schmitt M (2017) studied the unintended consequences of copay coupons, showing how discounts can paradoxically increase costs by reducing generic drug utilization. This research was published in the American Economic Journal: Economic Policy. 8. Dalen DM, Furu K, Locatelli M, and Strom S (2011) provided micro-evidence from Norwegian register data on the effects of generic substitution. Their findings were published in the European Journal of Health Economics. 9. Dalen DM, Locatelli M, and Strom S (2010) conducted a longitudinal analysis of generic substitution, with their work published as part of the CESifo Working Paper Series. 10. Danzon PM and Chao LW (2000) investigated whether regulation drives out competition in pharmaceutical markets. Their findings were published in the Journal of Law and Economics. 11. Farfan-Portet MI, Van de Voorde C, Vrijens F, and Vander Stichele R (2012) analyzed the socioeconomic determinants influencing patients' choice between generic and brand-name drugs within a reference price system in Belgium. This study was published in the European Journal of Health Economics. 12. Faunce T, Bai J, and Nguyen D (2010) assessed the impact of the Australia-US Free Trade Agreement on Australian medicines regulation and pricing. Their findings were published in the Journal of Generic Medicines. 13. Ferrario A, Chitan E, Seicas R, et al. (2016) reviewed progress in improving the affordability of medicines for non-communicable diseases in Moldova following the introduction of mandatory health insurance. This study was published in Health Policy and Planning. 14. Font JC (2016) examined the effects of deregulation on access to medicines in Peru. The findings were published in the Journal of International Development. 15. Foxon G, Fox G, and Craddy P (2015) explored whether EU payers are adapting biosimilar pricing and reimbursement processes to optimize healthcare savings. Their findings were published in Value in Health. 16. Frenzel A, Schmidt N, and Grahl J (2012) analyzed differences in biosimilar market penetration across EU5 countries, focusing on epoetine, granulocyte-colony stimulating factors, and growth hormones. This study was published in Value in Health. 17. Fukumoto D and Suzuki T (2017) investigated the impact of generic entry on off-patent branded medicines in the Japanese pharmaceutical market. Their findings were published in the Journal of Generic Medicines. 18. Fung V, Tager IB, Brand R, Newhouse JP, and Hsu J (2008) studied the effects of generic-only drug benefits on the use of inhaled corticosteroids among Medicare patients with asthma. This research was published in BMC Health Services Research. 19. Garattini L and Casadei G (2011) reviewed Italy’s experience with risk-sharing agreements in pharmaceuticals. Their findings were published in the International Journal of Technology Assessment in Health Care. 20. Garattini L, Motterlini N, and Cornago D (2008) compared the prices and distribution margins of in-patent drugs across seven European countries. This study was published in Health Policy. 21. Gissel C (2013) conducted a cost-effectiveness analysis within the context of German pharmaceutical price regulation. The findings were published in Value in Health. 22. Godman B, Persson M, Miranda J, et al. (2013) examined the potential for authorities to enhance the prescribing of generic atypical antipsychotics to conserve resources, with findings from Sweden. This study was published in the Journal of Pharmaceutical Health Services Research. 23. Godman B, Petzold M, Bennett K, et al. (2014) analyzed the prescribing patterns of oral generic risperidone across Europe and its implications for resource conservation. This research was published in BMC Medicine. 24. Gordon N, Stemmer SM, Greenberg D, and Goldstein DA (2016) compared the price trajectories of anti-tumor necrosis factor drugs in Israel and the USA, highlighting the influence of market regulation. Their findings were published in Value in Health. 25. Greene L, Singh RM, Carden MJ, et al. (2019) surveyed managed care and specialty pharmacy professionals to identify strategies for overcoming barriers to biosimilar adoption under the Biologics Price Competition and Innovation Act. This study was published in the Journal of Managed Care and Specialty Pharmacy. This format provides a clear, professional summary of each reference, suitable for a medical expert audience.
